title: TMI, an isoflavone from the fruits of Ficus altissima Blume, overcomes K562/ADR leukemia cells resistance by targeting Nrf2.
authors: Shen, Liyuan; Xu, Jingwen; Wang, Yihai; Yao, Jiaming; He, Xiangjiu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究异黄酮TMI通过靶向Nrf2蛋白克服白血病耐药，分子对接仅涉及小分子-蛋白互作，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，亦无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Chronic myeloid leukemia (CML) is a myeloproliferative tumor, which is prone to drug resistance during treatment. Previous studies have indicated that Ficus altissima Blume exhibits potential antitumor properties, with 5,7,2'-trihydroxy-4'-methoxy-6-(3-hydroxy-3-methylbutyl)-isoflavone (TMI) as its main active component. However, the antitumour activity of TMI and its underlying mechanisms remain unexplored. This study investigated the anti-proliferative effects of TMI on adriamycin (ADR)-resistant leukemia K562 cells (K562/ADR cells) and the mechanism of overcoming multidrug resistance (MDR). The findings demonstrated that TMI significantly downregulated P-glycoprotein (P-gp) and breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP) expression. It was confirmed that TMI triggered caspase-dependent apoptosis in K562/ADR and K562 cells. While reactive oxygen species accumulation and PI3K/AKT/mTOR mediated TMI's effect in K562 cells, these pathways were irrelevant to its apoptosis induction and MDR overcoming in K562/ADR cells. Further research found that the nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) expression was significantly suppressed by TMI treatment. In contrast, exposure to the Nrf2 agonist tert-butylhydroquinone resulted in upregulation of P-gp and BCRP protein levels in K562/ADR cells. This suggests that TMI's overcoming of K562/ADR cell drug resistance is associated with Nrf2 degradation. Finally, molecular docking analysis and cellular thermal shift assay experiments showed that TMI exerted anti-drug resistance effect by directly binding to Nrf2 protein. Collectively, TMI overcomes K562/ADR cell resistance primarily through targeting and inhibiting Nrf2 protein and decreasing drug efflux protein expression, ultimately promoting cell death. These results highlight TMI's potential as a drug-resistant leukemia therapy, while also suggesting that developing Nrf2-targeted inhibitors may represent a novel strategy for overcoming tumor drug resistance.
abstract_zh: 慢性髓性白血病（chronic myeloid leukemia, CML）是一种骨髓增殖性肿瘤，在治疗过程中易产生耐药性。既往研究表明，高山榕（Ficus altissima Blume）具有潜在的抗肿瘤特性，其主要活性成分为5,7,2'-三羟基-4'-甲氧基-6-(3-羟基-3-甲基丁基)-异黄酮（TMI）。然而，TMI的抗肿瘤活性及其潜在机制尚未被探索。本研究考察了TMI对阿霉素（adriamycin, ADR）耐药白血病K562细胞（K562/ADR细胞）的抗增殖作用及其克服多药耐药（multidrug resistance, MDR）的机制。研究结果表明，TMI显著下调P-糖蛋白（P-glycoprotein, P-gp）和乳腺癌耐药蛋白（breast cancer resistance protein, BCRP）的表达。实验证实，TMI在K562/ADR和K562细胞中触发caspase依赖性凋亡。虽然活性氧积累和PI3K/AKT/mTOR通路介导了TMI在K562细胞中的作用，但这些通路与其在K562/ADR细胞中的凋亡诱导和MDR克服无关。进一步研究发现，TMI处理显著抑制核因子E2相关因子2（nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2, Nrf2）的表达。相反，暴露于Nrf2激动剂叔丁基对苯二酚导致K562/ADR细胞中P-gp和BCRP蛋白水平上调。这表明TMI克服K562/ADR细胞耐药性与Nrf2降解相关。最后，分子对接分析和细胞热位移实验表明，TMI通过直接结合Nrf2蛋白发挥抗耐药作用。综上所述，TMI主要通过靶向并抑制Nrf2蛋白、降低药物外排蛋白表达来克服K562/ADR细胞耐药性，最终促进细胞死亡。这些结果凸显了TMI作为耐药白血病治疗药物的潜力，同时也提示开发Nrf2靶向抑制剂可能代表一种克服肿瘤耐药的新策略。
